correctness.rationale: The nine nonnegative type×recipient counts completely determine additive EF1, equivalent to U_i(s)+max_{g∈S_j}v_i(g)≥v_i(S_j) for all ordered i≠j. Backward induction on the finite adversarial game has exact alternation ∃type∀recipient over h remaining turns. The actual STRATEGY.json contains 42 reachable fair nodes, and a separately implemented exact-integer check confirms all 126 allocator responses: 74 immediate failures and the rest guaranteed fair successor states in the policy with no surviving seventh-turn branch. An independent exhaustive exact minimax recursion gives W_6(0)=false and W_7(0)=true; an independent dynamic program verifies prefix-EF1 feasibility for all 3279 fixed streams of 1..7 arrivals. This is an exhaustive finite proof for the fixed valuation vectors, not a sample. The universal two-type positive side is imported from cited literature and not re-proved by this certificate.
